justification: Yes. In `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/process/javap/ReflectionJavap.java`, the package depends on `org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.loader.DisposableURLClassLoader`; repo-wide, the target package is only imported by `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/loader/BytecodeLoader.java`, so its incoming coupling is very small. The `loader` package has broader outgoing coupling (`BytecodeLoader.java` imports model/util/process.javap packages, and `ResourceLoader.java` imports `jvmlang` and `util`), while `JavapProcess.java` only depends on `process.AbstractProcess`, which is widely reused by 13 in-repo classes. That makes `process.javap` depend on a less stable package (`loader`), which matches UD.
